senses.gloss: m. (v. גּוּמְרָא, a. גָּמַר I) spices put on coals, offered after dinner, perfume.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 6:6">Ber. VI, 6</cite>. Y. ib. 10ᵈ <he>מ׳ כיון שהעלה עשן וכ׳</he> as soon as the smoke rises from the burning spices &c.; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 18a:5">Sabb. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>מניחין מו׳</he>; Y. ib. I, 4ᵃ top <he>נותנין מג׳</he>, v. <cite ref="C01061"><he>גָּמַר</he> I</cite>.—Pl. <he>מוּגְמָרוֹת</he>.
